disclaimer: Thresholds are PLACEHOLDERS for testing. They are not taken from the AICTE Approval Process Handbook. Map each rule to a Handbook clause and set verified=true only after human verification.

rules.name: Required documents present
rules.description: All 11 required document types must be present

rules.name: No duplicate files
rules.description: No two documents of different types may be byte-identical

rules.name: Institution name consistent
rules.description: institution_name equals application form value in every document

rules.name: Trust/society name consistent
rules.description: trust_name equal across application, registration, land, NOC, FDR, financials

rules.name: Society registration number consistent
rules.description: society_reg_no equal between application form and registration certificate

rules.name: Land area consistent
rules.description: land_area_sqm equal across application, land document, building plan

rules.name: Built-up area consistent
rules.description: built_up_area_sqm equal across application, building plan, infrastructure report

rules.name: Intake consistent
rules.description: total_intake equal across application, NOC and affiliation letter

rules.name: Faculty count consistent
rules.description: faculty_count declared equals rows in faculty list

rules.name: Fire certificate valid
rules.description: fire certificate valid_to must be on/after application_date

rules.name: No future-dated documents
rules.description: Document dates must not be after application_date

rules.name: Deposit not matured
rules.description: FDR maturity_date must be after application_date

rules.name: PIN code consistent
rules.description: pincode equal across application, land, plan, fire certificate
